items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I thought the stuff he did on Blue Note, he captured what we were trying to do wonderfully. Later on – when I went back and recorded with him later on

ctx.x: It was – but I was waiting for something like, ah, back to Rudy again, and it just turned out to be . . .
There are a couple more musicians that you brought to the fore during the Blue Note time that I want to ask you about. One is Larry Willis, and the other is Charles Tolliver.
